statement: Delta Air Lines, Inc. focused on increasing flights at its core hubs in Atlanta, Detroit, Minneapolis-St. Paul, and Salt Lake City in 2024.
Delta Air Lines, Inc. improved operational efficiency at its coastal hubs in Boston, Los Angeles, New York-LaGuardia, New York-JFK, and Seattle in 2024.
Zoetis Inc. operates through two geographic operating segments: the United States (U.S.) and International.
Zoetis directly markets its products to veterinarians and livestock producers in approximately 45 countries across North America, Europe, Africa, Asia, Australia, and South America.
EXPAND ENERGY Corp received the first installment payment of $60 million related to the Eagle Ford asset divestiture to WildFire Energy I LLC in the Current Period (FY2024 Q2).

The deferred consideration from the Eagle Ford divestiture is recorded at fair value with an imputed rate of interest as a Level 2 input, with approximately $57 million and $58 million reflected in other current assets as of June 30, 2024 and December 31, 2023, respectively.
The Eagle Ford divestiture closed on March 20, 2023, with an effective date of October 1, 2022, and resulted in a gain of approximately $337 million, inclusive of post-closing adjustments.
American Tower Corporation's U.S. & Canada property segment revenue decreased by $6.5 million in FY2024 Q3 compared to the prior period.

The decrease in U.S. & Canada property segment revenue was primarily due to a $63.5 million decrease in other revenue from equipment removal and other fees, and a $32.1 million decrease from straight-line accounting.
Tenant billings growth of $57.0 million partially offset the decrease in U.S. & Canada property segment revenue.
The tenant billings growth in U.S. & Canada property segment was driven by $44.9 million from colocation leasing and amendments.
Asia-Pacific property segment revenue grew by $0.9 million in FY2024 Q3.
The growth in Asia-Pacific property segment revenue included $0.6 million from newly acquired or constructed sites.
APA Corp's subsidiary reached a positive final investment decision for the GranMorgu oil development in Block 58 offshore Suriname in October 2024.
The GranMorgu development will produce from the Krabdagu and Sapakara oil discoveries through a floating production, storage and offloading (FPSO) unit with a capacity of 220,000 barrels per day.
The GranMorgu FPSO unit is designed to accommodate future tie-back opportunities and minimize greenhouse gas emissions.
Total investment for the GranMorgu development is estimated at $10.5 billion, with APA's share contingent on an agreement with TotalEnergies.
Wells Fargo & Company received a $500,000 wire deposit in Q4 2024 related to legal services for persons designated under Executive Order 13224, conducted under an OFAC general license.
The $500,000 deposit generated no measurable gross revenue for Wells Fargo & Company in 2024.

CME Group Inc. is designated by the Financial Stability Oversight Council as a systemically important financial market utility under Title VIII of the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act.

CME and its DCMs (CBOT, NYMEX, and COMEX) are required to maintain capital in an amount at least equal to one year of projected operating expenses as well as cash, liquid securities, or a line of credit at least equal to six months of projected operating expenses.
CME, CBOT, NYMEX, and COMEX are regulated by the CFTC as Designated Contract Markets (DCM).
Abbott Laboratories' Medical Devices segment sales increased 13.7% in 2024 compared to 2023, excluding foreign exchange impact.

NextEra Energy, Inc. and Florida Power & Light Company (FPL) have preliminary estimates of recoverable storm restoration costs for Hurricanes Debby and Helene of approximately $0.3 billion and for Hurricane Milton of approximately $0.8 billion, respectively.

FPL's storm reserve balance was approximately $80 million prior to Hurricane Debby and was exceeded by the estimated recoverable costs for Debby by approximately $0.2 billion as of September 30, 2024.

FPL expects to seek recovery of approximately $1.2 billion for storm restoration costs and replenishing the storm reserve through a surcharge filed in the fourth quarter of 2024, covering calendar year 2025.
PPG Industries, Inc. identifies raw materials as its single largest production cost component.
PPG uses a wide variety of complex raw materials, including resins, solvents, reactants, titanium dioxide, additives, and epoxy.
PPG manages raw material supply through contracts with multiple sources and alternative material identification.
PPG evaluates alternative raw materials to support decarbonization and circular economy goals.
Northrop Grumman Corporation repaid $1.5 billion of 2.93 percent unsecured senior notes upon maturity in January 2025.
Zebra Technologies Corporation's total company sales increased 11.3% in FY2025 Q1 compared to FY2024 Q1.
The 11.3% sales increase was partially offset by a 0.7% impact from foreign currency translations and a (0.1)% impact from acquisitions.
Consolidated Organic Net sales growth was 11.9% in FY2025 Q1, excluding the effects of currency changes and acquisitions.
PACCAR's Parts segment sales were a record $1.69 billion in FY2025 Q1 compared to $1.68 billion in the prior period.
The increase in PACCAR Parts sales was attributed to higher sales in the U.S. and Canada.
Texas Instruments Incorporated's Analog segment revenue decreased 11% in Q2 2024 compared with Q2 2023.
Texas Instruments Incorporated's Embedded Processing segment revenue decreased 31% in Q2 2024 compared with Q2 2023.
Texas Instruments Incorporated's gross profit decreased $699 million, or 24%, in Q2 2024 compared with Q2 2023.
Huntington Ingalls Industries' Mission Technologies segment sales and service revenues increased $24 million or 4% in the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023.

The increase in Mission Technologies segment operating income was primarily driven by higher volumes in cyber electronic warfare and space, as well as higher equity income from nuclear and environmental joint ventures.
APA Corp's Egypt assets' gross production decreased 7 percent in FY2024 Q2 compared with FY2024 Q2 of the previous year.
APA Corp's Egypt assets' net production decreased 8 percent in FY2024 Q2 compared with FY2024 Q2 of the previous year.
Walmart Inc.'s holiday sales, including two record-breaking volume days leading up to Christmas, exceeded expectations during the fiscal year ending January 31.
NIKE, Inc.'s consolidated gross margin increased 120 basis points to 45.4% in the first quarter of fiscal 2025 compared to the prior year.
The gross margin expansion was primarily driven by lower NIKE Brand product costs, lower warehousing and logistics costs, and benefits from strategic pricing actions in the prior year.

Cboe Global Markets, Inc. had $400.0 million available through its revolving credit facility as of September 30, 2024, with the ability to borrow an additional $200.0 million by increasing commitments, subject to lender agreement.

Cboe Global Markets, Inc. had approximately $1.2 billion available to fund operations, capital expenditures, potential acquisitions, debt repayments, and dividends, net of minimum regulatory capital requirements of $173.1 million as of September 30, 2024.

Cboe Global Markets, Inc. repurchased 144,370 shares of its common stock under its share repurchase program during the three months ended September 30, 2024, at an average cost per share of $170.45, for a total value of $24.6 million.
Yum! Brands, Inc.'s Pizza Hut Division achieved its highest Super Bowl sales in the U.S. in the first quarter of 2025, with all digital orders processed through Byte Commerce.
Essex Property Trust, Inc. uses financial occupancy as a meaningful measure of occupancy because it considers the value of each vacant apartment home at its estimated market rate.
The Company calculates financial occupancy by comparing contractual rates for occupied apartment homes to estimated market rents for unoccupied apartment homes, excluding delinquency and concessions.
Oracle employees received more than five million hours of training in fiscal 2024.
Oracle employees accessed online learning content at an average rate of approximately two million views per month in fiscal 2024.
Arch Capital Group Ltd.'s mortgage segment reported $269 million of underwriting income in the 2024 third quarter.
The mortgage segment's combined ratio was 14.8% in the 2024 third quarter.
Kimberly-Clark Corporation's adjusted operating profit for the three months ended March 31, 2025 decreased 9.8% compared to the same period in 2024.
The decrease in adjusted operating profit was primarily due to lower net sales and adjusted gross profit, partially offset by lower marketing, research and general expenses.

Realty Income Corporation uses Annualized Adjusted EBITDA *re* and Annualized Pro Forma Adjusted EBITDA *re* as non-GAAP supplemental measures to evaluate operating performance and determine performance share award vesting.
Annualized Pro Forma Adjusted EBITDA *re* adjusts for acquisitions, dispositions, and transaction accounting to reflect a pro forma earnings run rate.

Deere & Company's performance in FY2024 was adversely affected by decreases in demand for agricultural equipment due to downturns in the agricultural industry and other factors, which varied by market.
Unfavorable market conditions in FY2024 led to lower sales volumes, higher sales discounts, higher receivable write-offs, and a higher provision for credit losses for Deere & Company.
Deere & Company expects certain unfavorable market conditions, including high unemployment, high interest rates, and lower business investment, to persist into FY2025.

Deere & Company's turf operations and construction and forestry segments have been materially impacted by recent adverse economic conditions, including decreases in construction activity and housing starts.
Deere & Company's earnings and cash flows could be reduced due to changes in market liquidity conditions caused by pervasive U.S. fiscal issues, economic conditions, or interest rate changes.
Applied Materials, Inc.'s Semiconductor Systems net revenue increased 1% in fiscal 2024 compared to fiscal 2023.
The increase in Semiconductor Systems net revenue was driven by customer investments in new capacity and new technology transitions.
Memory customers' spending in fiscal 2024 was higher due to increased investments in DRAM technology transitions.
Apple Inc.'s Services revenue reached $26.3 billion in the three months ended December 28, 2024.
LyondellBasell Industries N.V.'s O&P-Americas segment revenue decreased by $273 million, or 10%, in the first quarter of 2025 compared to the fourth quarter of 2024.
The O&P-Americas segment revenue decrease was primarily due to lower volumes from planned and unplanned outages.
The O&P-Americas segment revenue decrease included a 4% increase from higher ethylene and polyethylene average sales prices.
Moody's Corporation's Insurance segment ARR (2) grew 12% in FY2024 compared to FY2023.
Borg Warner Inc's Turbos & Thermal Technologies segment net sales decreased $88 million, or 6%, for the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023.
The decrease in Turbos & Thermal Technologies segment net sales was primarily due to approximately $77 million from reduced volume, mix, and net new business driven by a decline in market production.
Borg Warner Inc's Drivetrain & Morse Systems segment net sales decreased $84 million, or 6%, for the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023.

The decrease in Drivetrain & Morse Systems segment net sales excluding foreign currency impact was primarily due to approximately $80 million from reduced volume, mix, and net new business driven by a decline in market production.

Bristol-Myers Squibb Co's effective tax rate for the third quarter of 2024 was 27.5%, primarily impacted by changes in previously estimated annual effective tax rates resulting from jurisdictional earnings mix.

The effective tax rate for the third quarter of 2023 was 9.5%, primarily impacted by revised guidance regarding deductibility of certain research and development expenses which reduced income taxes by approximately $160 million.
Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc. classified its operations into three reportable segments: Studios, Networks, and DTC, as of September 30, 2024.

The Studios segment includes production and release of feature films, television program licensing, distribution to third parties and internal services, home entertainment distribution, consumer products, themed experiences, and interactive gaming.
The Networks segment consists of domestic and international television networks.
The DTC segment includes premium pay-TV and streaming services.
Teradyne, Inc.'s Wireless Test revenue was $36 million in Q2 2024.
Vulcan Materials Company returned $110.9 million to shareholders in FY2024 Q2 through $50.0 million of common stock repurchases and $60.9 million of dividends.
3M Company's Safety and Industrial business segment sales were flat in U.S. dollars for FY2024.
Roofing granules within 3M's Safety and Industrial segment experienced mid-single-digit growth in FY2024.
Valero Energy Corp reported $2.8 billion of net income attributable to Valero stockholders for the year ended December 31, 2024.
Valero Energy Corp's net income for 2024 decreased compared to $8.8 billion in 2023.

The AES Corporation has contracted and imported into the U.S. all solar panels necessary to complete its U.S. backlog of solar projects scheduled to finish construction and become operational in 2025.
For U.S. backlog of solar projects scheduled to finish construction and become operational in 2026 or 2027, the majority of panel supply is manufactured in the U.S.
The AES Corporation has contracted and imported into the U.S. all batteries needed for its U.S. energy storage projects scheduled to be completed in 2025.
For U.S. backlog of storage projects scheduled to finish construction and become operational in 2026 or 2027, approximately 80% of battery needs have been contracted.
The AES Corporation has contracted for U.S. domestically manufactured battery modules to support energy storage growth through 2027.
The AES Corporation has contracted and received delivery of all turbines for its U.S. backlog of wind projects scheduled to be completed in 2025.
Global Payments Inc. accounted for the EVO acquisition as a business combination, recognizing assets acquired and liabilities assumed at fair value as of the acquisition date.
The final estimated acquisition-date fair value of identifiable intangible assets from the EVO acquisition was $1,478,995 thousand.
Domino's Pizza, Inc.'s supply chain Segment Income increased $5.0 million, or 8.3%, in FY2024 Q2 primarily due to a $7.4 million increase in supply chain gross margin.
Domino's Pizza, Inc.'s supply chain Segment Income increased $21.0 million, or 19.4%, in the two fiscal quarters of FY2024 primarily due to a $24.3 million increase in supply chain gross margin.
Visa Inc. grew its total workforce from approximately 28,800 in fiscal 2023 to approximately 31,600 employees in fiscal 2024, an increase of 10 percent year over year.
Voluntary workforce turnover (rolling 12-month attrition) for Visa was 5 percent as of September 30, 2024.
Motorola Solutions, Inc. issued $400 million of 5.0% senior notes due 2029 and $900 million of 5.4% senior notes due 2034 during the three months ended March 30, 2024.
The net proceeds from the debt issuance were $1.3 billion after accounting for debt issuance costs and discounts.
A portion of the proceeds from the debt issuance was used to repurchase $1.0 billion aggregate principal amount of the Silver Lake Convertible Debt.
